FOUND-001.title: Conduct Foundation Event Storm for Foundation
FOUND-001.description:
Complete the foundation by capturing domain architecture through Foundation Event Storm.

Use these commands to populate foundation.json eventStorm field:
- fspec add-foundation-bounded-context <name>
- fspec remove-foundation-bounded-context <name> [--cascade]
- fspec add-aggregate-to-foundation <context> <aggregate>
- fspec remove-aggregate-from-foundation <context> <aggregate>
- fspec add-domain-event-to-foundation <context> <event>
- fspec remove-domain-event-from-foundation <context> <event>
- fspec add-command-to-foundation <context> <command>
- fspec remove-command-from-foundation <context> <command>
- fspec show-foundation-event-storm

Why this matters:
- Establishes bounded contexts for domain-driven design
- Enables tag ontology generation from domain model
- Provides foundation for architectural documentation
- Supports EXMAP-004 tag discovery workflow

See spec/AGENTS.md "Foundation Event Storm" section for detailed guidance.

PORT-001.title: Public engineering evidence pipeline
PORT-001.description: Parent requirement preserving Brandon's request: run unit, integration, and Playwright GUI tests in CI; publish approved requirements with descriptions, acceptance criteria, relationships, and statuses; publish test evidence; run single-pass non-load performance checks and provide security suggestions; create GitHub issues for actionable findings and iterate on them in this Codex project. The repository began empty. Children define independently verifiable user-facing outcomes.

architectureNotes.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/1. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

PORT-002.title: Traceable public requirements catalog
PORT-002.description: Visitors can inspect the explicitly public requirement subset derived from FSPEC, including status, description, acceptance criteria, and related work units. Internal/non-public work units are excluded.

userStory.action: inspect approved requirements and their status, description, acceptance criteria, and relationships
userStory.benefit: understand the development approach without relying on a Jira-style workflow

rules.text: Only requirements explicitly marked for public display are published; internal setup work is excluded.
Each published requirement shows its current FSPEC status, description, acceptance criteria, and related requirements.

examples.text: A hiring leader opening the requirements page sees PORT-002 with its current status and acceptance criteria, while FOUND-001 remains private.
When PORT-002 relates to PORT-006, the requirements page links both IDs without rendering unrelated setup records.

architectureNotes.text: Implementation: Publish only reviewed, explicitly public requirements and linked Gherkin criteria; omit internal work units.
GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/2. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

PORT-003.title: Unit test suite in CI
PORT-003.description: A deterministic unit suite runs for pull requests and production branch commits. Failures make the quality check fail and produce a machine-readable result.

architectureNotes.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/3. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

rules.text: Unit checks are deterministic and run for pull requests and production branch updates.

examples.text: When a unit check fails, the quality workflow fails and retains machine-readable results.

userStory.action: run fast deterministic unit checks before merging
userStory.benefit: catch regressions early and prevent failed quality from publishing

PORT-004.title: Integration test suite in CI
PORT-004.description: An integration suite exercises requirement projection and quality-report generation from the real FSPEC data. Failures make the quality check fail and produce a machine-readable result.

architectureNotes.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/4. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

rules.text: Integration checks exercise FSPEC data through public projection and evidence generation.

examples.text: A public-only catalog and associated check summary are generated from the repository work units.

userStory.action: verify that repository requirements and check results project into the built site

PORT-005.title: Playwright GUI tests in CI
PORT-005.description: Playwright browser tests build and serve the site, then verify the public requirements and quality pages. Failures make the quality check fail and preserve the HTML report as an Actions artifact.

architectureNotes.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/5. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

rules.text: Browser checks verify requirements and quality evidence in Chromium before deployment.

examples.text: A visitor sees requirement status and the evidence summary after the static site is served.

userStory.action: inspect the requirements and quality evidence pages in a real browser
userStory.benefit: confirm the public experience works as presented

PORT-006.title: Published quality and test evidence
PORT-006.description: The deployed site publishes a sanitized summary of the latest build's unit, integration, GUI, performance, and security checks, with timestamps, status, and evidence limits. No credentials, raw logs, or browser traces are published.

architectureNotes.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/6. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

userStory.action: review the latest test and quality results
userStory.benefit: see what was checked before a site release

rules.text: Each test and review result must show a timestamp, outcome, and concise summary for the same build.

examples.text: After all checks pass, the evidence page lists unit, integration, browser, performance, and security outcomes while raw traces remain in private CI artifacts.

PORT-007.title: Single-pass performance checks
PORT-007.description: A non-load performance smoke run visits each selected public route once, records response and browser navigation timings, and reports measurements without concurrency, repeated sampling, or claims of benchmark precision.

architectureNotes.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/7. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

rules.text: Performance checks make one page navigation per selected route and never generate concurrent load.

examples.text: The run records HTTP status and browser navigation timing for the home route once.

userStory.action: measure one navigation through a selected route
userStory.benefit: spot obvious delivery regressions without generating load

PORT-008.title: Security review suggestions
PORT-008.description: The pipeline runs dependency and source-level security checks and presents owner-reviewable suggestions, distinguishing verified scanner findings from general recommendations.

architectureNotes.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/8. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

rules.text: Automated dependency and source checks produce actionable, sanitized guidance.

examples.text: The dependency audit has zero high or critical findings and the source review finds no prohibited patterns.

userStory.action: review dependency and source security signals with practical suggestions
userStory.benefit: reduce preventable risk without publishing sensitive details

PORT-009.title: Finding to GitHub issue loop
PORT-009.description: Each accepted actionable finding has a GitHub issue linked to its requirement or evidence. Issue work is iterated in this Codex project and status changes are reflected in the public requirement view when the item is tagged public.

architectureNotes.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/9. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

PORT-010.title: Quality-gated Cloudflare Pages deployment
PORT-010.description: Pull requests and production-branch commits run required quality checks. Cloudflare Pages publishes a build only when the same unit, integration, Playwright, single-pass performance, and security report generation commands succeed.

architectureNotes.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/brandonhoule1/portfolio/issues/10. The issue tracks progress and is linked from the public requirement catalog.

rules.text: Cloudflare Pages must run the repository quality command on the exact commit before publishing that commit to production.

examples.text: When the production build executes the complete unit, integration, Playwright, one-pass performance, and security checks successfully, Pages publishes the generated dist directory.
When any required check fails, Pages must not publish that revision to production and GitHub Actions must retain sanitized diagnostic artifacts.

userStory.action: view the latest production build and its quality evidence
userStory.benefit: trust that the published revision passed its documented checks

userStory.action: understand Brandon’s leadership story and inspect career evidence
userStory.benefit: assess fit and see how his approach works

examples.text: A visitor follows the single How this was made link to requirements, quality results, and manual tests.

PORT-012.title: Resume-backed Brandon profile
PORT-012.description: Make the home experience an executive-first Who is Brandon profile grounded in the actual AI Enablement resume, career facts, and a downloadable original resume PDF.

userStory.action: review Brandon’s career and download his actual resume
userStory.benefit: evaluate his experience using source-backed evidence

PORT-013.description: Use one navigation destination for the requirements grid, acceptance criteria/status/relationships/GitHub links, and latest quality evidence.

userStory.action: inspect requirements, automated quality, and manual cases in one area
userStory.benefit: understand what was built and how it is checked

PORT-014.title: Leadership demonstrations and visuals
PORT-014.description: Present a portfolio-specific 30/60/90 plan, animated original diagrams, audience perspectives, and executive leadership demonstrations, labeling fictional data and prototypes clearly.

userStory.action: read and download the manual test cases

PORT-016.title: Career proof, executive briefing, and insights
PORT-016.description: Add three resume-grounded case studies, an executive briefing, and the three AI-first insights proposed in the referenced conversation, without unsupported outcome claims.

userStory.action: review career evidence, leadership briefings, and operating insights
userStory.benefit: understand Brandon’s perspective without confusing it with claimed results

examples.text: A visitor can inspect career evidence and leadership decision material with source and scenario labels.
